setup: sudo apt-get update && sudo env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 build-essential autoconf bison ca-certificates curl gnupg lsb-release locales libssl-dev libncurses-dev zlib1g-dev libyaml-dev libreadline-dev libffi-dev libgmp-dev libgdbm-dev libdb-dev uuid-dev inotify-tools unzip procps supervisor universal-ctags

sudo sed -i 's/^# *en_US.UTF-8 UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8 UTF-8/' /etc/locale.gen && sudo locale-gen >/dev/null && printf 'export LANG=en_US.UTF-8
export LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8
export ELIXIR_ERL_OPTIONS=+fnu
' | sudo tee /etc/profile.d/blank_slate.sh >/dev/null

curl -fsSL https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/postgresql-keyring.gpg && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/postgresql-keyring.gpg] http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt $(lsb_release -cs)-pgdg main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list >/dev/null && sudo apt-get update && sudo env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 postgresql-17 postgresql-client-17 libpq-dev
curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh && printf 'export PATH="%s/.local/share/mise/shims:%s/.local/bin:$PATH"\n' "$HOME" "$HOME" | sudo tee /etc/profile.d/mise.sh >/dev/null
cd /workspaces/blank_slate && MISE_QUIET=1 MISE_TERMINAL_PROGRESS=0 mise install erlang
cd /workspaces/blank_slate && MISE_QUIET=1 MISE_TERMINAL_PROGRESS=0 mise install elixir nodejs
cd /workspaces/blank_slate && MISE_QUIET=1 MISE_TERMINAL_PROGRESS=0 mise exec -- mix local.hex --force && MISE_QUIET=1 MISE_TERMINAL_PROGRESS=0 mise exec -- mix local.rebar --force

cd /workspaces/blank_slate && MISE_QUIET=1 MISE_TERMINAL_PROGRESS=0 mise exec -- npm install -g --prefix "$HOME/.local" --no-fund --no-audit --no-progress --loglevel=error @anthropic-ai/claude-code @openai/codex @google/gemini-cli opencode-ai

mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/gh/extensions" && (gh extension install basecamp/gh-signoff || git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/basecamp/gh-signoff.git "$HOME/.local/share/gh/extensions/gh-signoff")

printf "listen_addresses = '127.0.0.1'\n" | sudo tee -a /etc/postgresql/17/main/postgresql.conf >/dev/null && sudo pg_ctlcluster 17 main start && sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "ALTER USER postgres WITH PASSWORD 'postgres'"
cd /workspaces/blank_slate && MISE_QUIET=1 MISE_TERMINAL_PROGRESS=0 mise exec -- mix setup
